recipes.name: Salty Sesame and Dark Chocolate Chip Cookies
Egg Cream Carbonated Milk & Dark Chocolate Drops
recipes.notes: Soft tender milk cookie base infused with dark chocolate syrup, malt, and cold club soda for an airy egg cream lift. Fold in chilled seltzer right before portioning. Bake 10-12 min. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Black & White Malted Brownie Cookies
recipes.notes: Melted chocolate + whipped egg/sugar for a crackly top; chill both doughs 20 min and scoop half vanilla, half chocolate into marbled drops. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Coca-Cola Molasses Crinkle Cookies
recipes.notes: Reduce 2 L Mexican Coke to 1.5 cups of syrup (4x) and use it in place of molasses. Roll 1.5-inch balls in sugar; bake 8-10 min. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Cherry Phosphate Shortbread Thumbprints
recipes.notes: Thumbprint base with cherry extract & tart juice in place of lemon; chill dough 3 hours, roll in sugar, press wells, fill with wild cherry bark & acid phosphate jam (stir phosphate in off-heat). Cherry phosphate reference: https://www.artofdrink.com/soda/cherry-phosphate (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Sarsaparilla Millionaire's Shortbread Bars
recipes.notes: Bake pressed shortbread crust 25 min at 350°F. Cook caramel to 240°F (soft ball), then stir in vanilla and sarsaparilla extract off-heat (root beer caramel method: https://cleverpinkpirate.com/root-beer-caramel-recipe/). Top with thin white chocolate, dust with powdered sugar, cut into bars. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Orange Creamsicle Drops
recipes.notes: Rub orange zest into the sugars; fold in white chocolate chips. Bake 10-12 min at 350°F until edges are light golden; drizzle with orange-vanilla glaze once cool. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)
